source_text:
19.10 Κύριε, σῶσον τὸν βασιλέα σου, καὶ ἐπάκουσον
ἡμῶν.
Νῦν δὲ τέως ἡμῖν τὸν βασιλέα σῶσον ∆αυίδ.
pass_a_gloss: Lord, save the king of-you, and hear-upon us. Now and for-the-present to-us the king save David.
pass_b_english: “Lord, save your king, and hear us” (Psalm 19:10).
And now, for the present, save for us the king David.

choices.term: Νῦν δὲ τέως ἡμῖν τὸν βασιλέα σῶσον Δαυίδ
choices.english: now, for the present, save for us the king David
choices.why: τέως limits the petition to the present; the named king is David. Not ‘save the eternal king forever’ as the whole gloss.
rejected: save us instead of the king

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
